text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Guess I'll make like a ninja and vanish for today.
Thanks for telling me all that, sweetie.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I like chatting with you though, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Look at you saying such cute things~.
Still, training's gonna start soon, so—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Tran...-chan!
Are you still there?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Just now... I heard something super incredible! I thought our resident informant might want to know!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, fine then. By all means, do tell me that story♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (Freshness is everything when it comes to info. ...Don't hold it against me, Trai-chan!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, time slipped away, and Transcend ended up skipping training altogether..."
